corrections.disposition: Removed unsupported one-or-two-bottleneck frequency, cure inference and automatic immunogenic-death/step-completion claims; retained conditional framework, access and safety.
Removed automatic PD-1-response and universal conversion implications; separated beta-catenin from PTEN/PIK3CA mistargeting. Pancreatic model and historical clinical claims retain defined scope.

Missing self is an altered inhibitory input rather than guaranteed killing. Fc-engineered margetuximab is not called an afucosylated antibody; the label retains in-vitro scope. Shared ligand names do not establish relative affinity or competitive dominance.
Marker presence is not a function assay; differentiated programmes remain plastic/contextual, and cytotoxic human CD4 evidence is retained separately.

Inducibility, basal display, recognition and killing remain distinct. JAK1/JAK2 interferon dependencies are not equated. The Garcia-Diaz correction body is inaccessible and its axis requirement remains partial.
Biomarkers, selected evaluable denominators, single-arm combinations, region/area denominators and clinical comparative benefit are separated.
